I have successfully fixed the issue where `Panel` titles and subtitles were missing the panel background style. I verified the fix with tests for both titles and subtitles, including cases with custom styles and background/border colors.

The `Panel` title and subtitle were missing the panel background style because they were only stylized with the `partial_border_style` (border color) instead of the `border_style` (background + border color). I updated `rich/panel.py` to use `border_style` for both `title_text` and `subtitle_text` when applying the base style using `stylize_before`.
